features: CINEMATIC POWERFUL SOUND (30W): Enjoy rich, loud, and room-filling audio with the Tronica Enjoy V2 30W portable Bluetooth home theater system. The wooden multimedia speaker delivers clear vocals, deep bass, and balanced sound for movies, music, gaming, TV shows, YouTube, FM radio, and daily home entertainment.

WOODEN CABINET WITH DEEP BASS OUTPUT: Built with a premium wooden acoustic cabinet, this speaker helps improve sound resonance and reduce unwanted vibration. The high-efficiency mid-sub driver produces natural bass, crisp dialogue, and clear music playback, making it suitable for bedrooms, living rooms, desktops, and home theater setups.

5-IN-1 MULTI-CONNECTIVITY SPEAKER: Play your favourite songs easily through Bluetooth wireless streaming, USB pen drive, AUX input, FM radio, and remote-controlled playback. This multimedia speaker gives flexible audio options for mobile phones, laptops, Smart TVs, PCs, tablets, and other compatible devices.

LED DISPLAY & FULL-FUNCTION REMOTE: The front LED display clearly shows active modes and playback status, while the included remote control lets you change volume, switch modes, skip tracks, and manage inputs from a distance. Enjoy easy control while watching movies, listening to music, or relaxing at home.

COMPACT PORTABLE HOME ENTERTAINMENT SYSTEM: Lightweight, stylish, and easy to move, this single-unit wooden Bluetooth speaker is perfect for living room, bedroom, office desk, study room, small parties, and indoor gatherings. A great choice for users looking for a portable speaker with loud sound, bass, FM radio, USB, AUX, remote, and cinematic audio performance.

30W POWERFUL CINEMATIC AUDIO: Experience rich, room-filling sound with a robust 30W RMS power output. Built as a high-performance single tower speaker, the premium acoustic wooden cabinet houses a high-efficiency sub-woofer driver that delivers crystal-clear vocals and deep, natural heavy bass for immersive movie nights, gaming sessions, and house parties

VERSATILE 5-IN-1 MULTIMEDIA CONNECTIVITY: Stream your favorite music playlists wirelessly via stable, long-range Bluetooth. This versatile audio sound box also supports plug-and-play USB flash drives, a 3.5mm AUX input for direct wire connections, and features a built-in digital FM Radio player to tune into local stations with strong signal reception

UNIVERSAL SMART TV & DEVICE COMPATIBILITY: Designed to seamlessly connect with all your home entertainment gear. Effortlessly pair this portable mini home theater system with your Smart TV, smartphone, tablet, laptop, desktop PC, or gaming console for an instant, high-fidelity audio upgrade

SMART LED DISPLAY & ALL-FUNCTION REMOTE CONTROL: Navigate your multimedia entertainment from the comfort of your couch. The bright, clear front-facing LED display panel shows active input modes and track numbers, while the fully functional IR remote control lets you manage volume levels, tracks, and modes easily

PORTABLE WOODEN DESIGN: Crafted from premium high-density wood, the acoustic enclosure enhances sound resonance while minimizing audio distortion. Its compact, space-saving layout functions like a mini desktop computer speaker, allowing you to easily move it between your living room, bedroom, or home office setup

COMPLETE PACKAGE CONTENTS: Includes one 30W speaker cabinet unit, one infrared remote control for convenient operation, one AUX cable for wired connections, and one comprehensive user manual with setup instructions and troubleshooting guidance
